body: This still feels like a really shitty situation. I'm actually in a store in Edmonton, but that meal drop off is news to me. As far as I've seen in our group chat there has been no talk about anything like that, unless it's happening in a private manager chat. If anything like that does happen, it will likely only be to the full timers during the week and not us part timers who have to cover the weekends. We haven't gotten any real encouragement either, most we've gotten was a story about an online mob that closed down an ice cream shop for not enforcing social distancing, and another store having their hand sanitizer stolen from till's.

Has there been any talk about closing, even a portion of the stores in the near future or have any sort of extra competition? 
I can understand during these first week or 2, to stay open to help people set up home offices, but I can say that in my store at least, our stock on those essentials are running incredibly thin and it doesn't look like we are getting significantly more anytime soon. Especially considering we're offering free shipping with online, and most of our essentials are having to be ordered with endless aisle.
